system.description:
You spend a bonus action and spend a superiority to introduce the highest stakes gamble you can make.

All willing creatures within 60 feet of you gains a +4 bonus to their critical threat range, until the end of each of their turns, but they also gain vulnerability to the next instance of damage they take before the end of your next turn.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
